newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine consumer inflation 0.5 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Argentine consumer inflation 0.5 pct in Jan.

text.p: Argentine consumer prices rose by 0.5 percent in January, compared with a rise of 0.3 percent in January 1996 and a drop in prices of 0.3 percent in December, the Economy Ministry said on Tuesday.
Wholesale prices rose by 0.2 percent in January, compared with 0.2 percent wholesale inflation in the same month of 1996 and 0.1 percent deflation in December.
The rise in January took 12-month consumer price inflation to 0.2 percent, compared with 0.7 percent in January 1996 and 0.054 percent in December.

Wholesale price inflation over the 12-month period was 2.1 percent, the same rate as in December. No comparative figure was available for the 12 months until last January because of the introduction of a new index series last year.
Economists on average forecast January monthly consumer inflation at 0.2 percent, according to a Reuters poll.
